market_summary: All five monitored assets (XAUUSD, EURUSD, GBPUSD, XAGUSD, BTCUSD) are exhibiting post-flush consolidation in the late New York session, pinned below their respective descending VWAP and EMA50 baselines and trading below session Value Area Lows. RVOL has completely dried up across the board (ranging 0.30 to 0.80), with no yellow RVOL > 2.0 expansion spikes present on the signal bars. With delta slopes flattening or diverging, and XAUUSD situated in a POSITIVE_DAMPENING gamma regime above its 3870 Gamma Flip, market conditions favor disciplined capital preservation with HOLD across all instruments.

signals.rationale: Evaluating the 7-point confluence checklist: 1) Volume Profile: Price at 3879.01 is below VAL (3884.90) and below POC (3978.13). 2) CVD: Header shows CVD -6.40 with a BEARISH label, agreeing with macro trend, but cvd_slope is positive (+1.81) indicating diminishing selling pressure. 3) Session: NEW_YORK_SESSION late-day tape. 4) Trend: Price remains firmly below declining VWAP (3931.10) and EMA50 baseline (3910.85). 5) ATR envelope: Price is mid-channel between lower ATR band (3865.91) and EMA20 (3884.65). 6) RVOL: RVOL is 0.801 (grey volume bar, 20 bars since last yellow spike), indicating lack of institutional momentum. 7) S/R & GEX: GEX regime is POSITIVE_DAMPENING with price hovering above Gamma Flip (3870.06), capped overhead by Call Wall #2 (3885.12) and supported by Session Low (3852.35) and Put Wall #1 (3819.64); dampening regime favors mean-reversion chop over trend continuation. Conclusion: Setup is consolidating mid-range in low volume, warranting a strict HOLD.
